sam: Following up from today's all-hands Q&A 11 quick clarifications about hybrid/offsite ops (travel, hoteling, reimbursements). Dropping bullets so folks can share with teams.

maya: Short answers up front: Expensely is live for everyone; hoteling windows clarified per city; visa/caregiver support available via Facilities; submit guest exceptions early.

leah: Expense notes: use tag OFFSITE:<team-name> in Expensely so Finance auto-routes. Standard reimbursement target is 10 business days after a complete submission. Missing receipts -> hold notice.

jess: Contractors  which tool? We have external PMs who need to claim travel.

maya: Contractors use Expensely by default. Managers must pre-approve contractor travel in writing (email ok). If a contractor's statement of work requires Concur, follow that contract and cc Finance.

ron: Hoteling in SFO  why are focus rooms blocked mornings? Our weekly design standups hit the same rooms.

leah: We introduced a daily-check-in rule to prevent phantom holds. Peak window 8am11am: >2hr advance booking required for blocks >60 minutes. Teams can request a recurring allocation for a week at a time via facilities@redwood.com if they justify business need.

sam: Per-diem and city overrides? Someone asked about London/NYC.

maya: Base per-diem stays $60/day. For high-cost cities submit a city-rate request in the offsite form; approvals go to Finance (typical review 3 business days).

jess: Visa and caregiver accommodations for international attendees?

leah: Facilities will coordinate visas for attendees on the official list and cover standard processing fees; expedite costs covered where needed. For caregivers or nursing parents: we have a reserved caregiver room option at the venue if requested 3 weeks in advance. Submit details in the offsite form or DM me.

ops-bot: Reminder: Offsite RSVP + dietary + special accommodations form closes 2026-07-15 23:59 UTC. Link in all-hands doc.

sam: Guests policy: can folks bring partners to the cocktail night?

maya: Managers may approve one guest for social-only events. Company covers event ticket; guests' travel/hotel are employee responsibility unless pre-approved. For hardship exceptions (e\.g\. caregiving), tag People-ops and we'll review a travel-waiver request.

leah: Action items: I'll publish a short FAQ with the OFFSITE tag examples and caregiver checklist; Maya will update the all-hands notes with hoteling windows per city; Facilities will open a locker pilot sign-up in WorkplaceBook.

sam: Thanks everyone 1 I'll circulate to my team and collect any edge cases. :thumbsup:
